name: V actor spike (#47)
author: Edgemodders
description: #47's spike for EDGEdir and REDcode: can V act out a workspot? Reads V's body, plays the game's own player workspots on V through a device spawned at V's feet, switches V's third-person body and camera on and off, and, as the fallback, spawns a photo mode copy of V, dresses it in V's clothes and plays the workspot on it. Section 7 writes two workspots of its own through REDbridge (one on V's skeleton, one on the NPC rig) and plays and jumps them on V and on the copy. Asks for the bridge and archives permissions.
